scope: Source-level bridge and contract evidence only. These audits do not prove that a vendor client loaded or followed Alatyr instructions.
required_runtime_checks: observe instruction auto-load and precedence in the exact client version
route an exact alias and an ambiguous request through the installed operation surfaces
confirm read-only discussion does not escalate to modify, commit, publish, or live-external action
confirm client tool permissions do not replace Alatyr current-scope authorization
confirm selected skills and prompts remain thin routes to target-owned contracts
record delegation backend, isolation, model, and result evidence or keep delegation unverified
show the portable ASCII diagram fallback and record any richer presentation evidence
record post-install or post-update delivery as sent, skipped, or blocked

audits.loading_behavior: No vendor auto-load behavior is assumed; the target must record the exact client and manual or native route before claiming support.
precedence_risks: Unknown clients can ignore, partially load, or reorder repository instructions.
residual_limits: Generic compatibility proves only a portable manual route, never vendor behavior.

audits.loading_behavior: Use the root and applicable scoped AGENTS.md files according to the selected client's implementation of the shared convention.
precedence_risks: The AGENTS.md convention does not make every client use identical hierarchy, conflict, or permission behavior.
residual_limits: A protocol-compatible label requires exact-client evidence before runtime support is claimed.

audits.loading_behavior: Use the applicable AGENTS.md chain and the Alatyr generic bridge; record the exact Codex client, project root, configuration, skills, sandbox, approvals, and subagent evidence.
precedence_risks: User and nested instructions can alter effective context; sandbox or approval settings can restrict tools but cannot grant Alatyr authorization.
residual_limits: CLI, IDE, desktop, cloud, and remote clients require separate current evidence.

audits.loading_behavior: Use CLAUDE.md as the native thin import route to root AGENTS.md; inspect managed, user, project, local, nested, rule, import, and exclusion sources.
precedence_risks: Claude treats instruction files as context rather than enforcement, combines multiple scopes, and can exclude project files through settings.
residual_limits: Memory, hooks, permissions, skills, and subagents require exact-client evidence.

audits.loading_behavior: Use GEMINI.md as the default bridge unless target Gemini settings select different context filenames; inspect settings, policies, skills, and agents.
precedence_risks: context.fileName and include-directory settings can replace or expand the expected instruction set.
residual_limits: Gemini CLI and other Gemini surfaces do not inherit capability evidence from one another.

audits.loading_behavior: Use repository-wide and applicable path-specific instructions according to the selected Copilot product; route the Alatyr gate prompt through canonical target files.
precedence_risks: Copilot products support different instruction, prompt, skill, custom-agent, and permission subsets; nearest AGENTS.md can take precedence.
residual_limits: Cloud agent, code review, CLI, IDE agent mode, and chat require product-specific evidence.

audits.loading_behavior: Prefer the always-applied project rule; retain .cursorrules only as a legacy compatibility candidate and record which path actually loaded.
precedence_risks: Project, user, scoped, AGENTS, and legacy rules can overlap; client versions differ in nested AGENTS support.
residual_limits: Rule selection, skills, subagents, permissions, and model evidence require the exact Cursor version.

audits.loading_behavior: Use the thin Devin/Cascade bridge and inspect repository instruction ingestion, generated or pinned Knowledge, skills, review rules, and environment blueprints separately.
precedence_risks: Repository files can be copied into mutable product Knowledge whose trigger, pin, enabled state, and freshness differ from Git.
residual_limits: Devin, Devin Review, and Cascade/Desktop behaviors need separate target evidence.

audits.loading_behavior: Treat Windsurf paths as legacy compatibility candidates and bind the exact client now serving Cascade behavior before selecting a route.
precedence_risks: Current Windsurf documentation redirects into Devin/Cascade documentation, while legacy clients retain older rule and memory behavior.
residual_limits: Do not claim current Windsurf runtime support from legacy bridge files alone.

audits.loading_behavior: Use root AGENTS.md when no target-owned .junie/AGENTS.md overrides it; inspect Junie playbook, rules, legacy guidelines, and global guidance before accepting precedence.
precedence_risks: A target .junie/AGENTS.md can replace the root AGENTS.md path instead of supplementing it.
Global and project guidance may both load and must not grant missing Alatyr authorization.
residual_limits: IDE and CLI versions can load guidance differently.
No reviewed Junie execution report is bundled with this source admission.

audits.loading_behavior: Use root AGENTS.md as the Alatyr bridge and inspect all Cline-compatible workspace rule sources because Cline can aggregate and toggle them.
precedence_risks: Multiple compatible rule formats can duplicate or contradict the root bridge.
A user can disable a detected rule in the client UI for the current session.
residual_limits: Rule activation can depend on client toggles and path conditions.
No reviewed Cline execution report is bundled with this source admission.

audits.loading_behavior: Use root AGENTS.md as the canonical bridge and inspect general, mode-specific, global, and legacy Roo rule sources before recording effective precedence.
precedence_risks: Mode-specific and general rules are combined and can conflict with the root bridge.
AGENTS.md loading can be disabled by client configuration.
residual_limits: Custom modes can change tools and instruction composition independently of Alatyr.
No reviewed Roo Code execution report is bundled with this source admission.

audits.loading_behavior: Use root and applicable nested AGENTS.md files as the Alatyr bridge; inspect Kiro steering inclusion modes and custom-agent resources before accepting effective context.
precedence_risks: Always, file-match, automatic, and manual steering can add competing instructions.
Custom agents do not automatically inherit every steering resource.
residual_limits: Steering inclusion and custom-agent resource behavior require exact-client evidence.
No reviewed Kiro execution report is bundled with this source admission.

audits.loading_behavior: Use generated .rules as Zed Agent's first-match thin bridge to root AGENTS.md and the compact Alatyr bootstrap; inspect every compatibility path and attribute external agents to their actual surface.
precedence_risks: A higher-priority compatibility file can prevent Zed from selecting root AGENTS.md.
External agents opened inside Zed retain their own instruction and permission behavior.
residual_limits: First-match precedence depends on every compatible file present in the target.
External and terminal agents in Zed do not inherit Zed Agent guarantees.
No reviewed Zed Agent execution report is bundled with this source admission.

audits.loading_behavior: Bind the exact OpenCode V1 or V2 runtime before interpreting loading: V1 selects local AGENTS.md ahead of CLAUDE.md, while V2 combines global, root, and discovered nested AGENTS.md files.

variant_loading.v1: Local AGENTS.md wins over CLAUDE.md; custom opencode.json instructions can add sources.
variant_loading.v2: Global and hierarchical AGENTS.md files combine; CLAUDE.md fallback is absent and configured instructions are not currently resolved.

precedence_risks: Global and project AGENTS.md files are combined without automatic conflict resolution.
Nested instructions are discovered as files or directories are traversed and can change effective context.
residual_limits: Instruction conflicts remain a target-adapter concern.
No reviewed OpenCode execution report is bundled with this source admission.
